p7_b0.ocr: In the rapidly evolving technology landscape of the Asia-Pacific region, the trends in monthly active users and open source contributions are pivotal indicators of growth and engagement in the software sector.

p7_b1.ocr: Recent data reveals that the total monthly active users surged to 30M in January 2024, reflecting a substantial increase from the previous month, where the figure stood at 29M, indicating a growth rate of 4.5%. Furthermore, the percentage of active users contributing to open source projects has reached 5.0%, up from 3.4% in December 2023, showcasing an upward trend in community involvement.
